facts.fact: A World Bank work plan for June 2026 to July 2027 transfers a Chichewa language data trust, built in an earlier phase on World Bank infrastructure from Malawian media archives and National Statistical Office recordings, to the Malawi Research and Education Network (MAREN) to run, with public launch staged for the Geneva AI Summit 2027.

systems.platform: World Bank infrastructure, to move to MAREN open-source stack
